intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Dairy-free-ice-cream and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Dairy-free ice cream can be at risk for gluten contamination due to shared equipment and certain flavorings that may contain gluten. It's essential to verify ingredient sources and preparation methods.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Dairy-free-ice-cream can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.
